description: A half-written New task draft is discarded silently when the person switches project and comes back. Edit drafts on existing tasks survive the same round trip. Same root cause as F-073-02.
expected: The New task draft persists per project and Actor like edit drafts, or the switch warns that it will be discarded.
actual: After Harbor → Lantern the New task panel is gone and the title is lost
suggested_fix: Persist the New task draft in the same per-workspace draft storage.
